purpose: Offline engineering evidence for GPT children that operate a page
evidenceRole: stable Chrome page facts plus a cheap current-demand projection that every GPT page Child iteration must consume before editing

supports: offline re-projection and deterministic regression from one stable capture epoch
doesNotReplace: real GPT task execution when the task requires it

denominator.rule: A child is in scope when it reads, navigates, clicks, types, uploads, waits on, checkpoints, or obtains media from a page. DOM terminology does not define the denominator.
